designPhilosophy: A clean, high-impact, premium product launch canvas merging the minimalist modular clarity of Notion's landing page with the bold typographic weight and immersive dark/light spaces of Apple's launch sites. We reject physical place metaphors, complex floating glass layers, and dry tabular lists in favor of massive, confident headlines, clean flat cards (bento grids), highly functional terminal mockups, and vibrant interaction cues.

distinctiveMoves: Massive viewport-scaled geometric display typography in bold weights.
Immersive dual-mode spaces: pure white canvas (Light Mode) and absolute pitch black (Dark Mode).
Modular bento-grid feature boxes separated by razor-thin 1px borders.
High-contrast terminal readouts resembling premium software capture frames.
Snappy, responsive hover scaling and clean vertical fade Reveals.

designExecutionHandoff.primaryExperienceGoal: Deliver a beautiful, high-impact public product launch landing page combining Notion's structural simplicity and Apple's bold typography, clean bento-grid features, and sleek white/black spaces.

surfacePlan.goal: Oversized bold display typography centered layout. A clean, premium subhead and a highly polished embedded terminal playbook readout below.
A modern bento-grid layout containing features framed inside clean, flat outline boxes with subtle rounded-hover scaling transitions.
Monospaced code outputs styled inside a sleek black panel with hot action copy triggers.

visualResetStrategy.resetPalette: Resets warm parchment and deep olive to absolute titanium white (#ffffff) and space black (#000000) canvas spaces, using vibrant Apple Blue (#0071e3) interactive points.
visualResetStrategy.resetTypography: Resets wide-tracked serif all-caps to oversized, bold geometric display sans headlines with tight line-heights, and highly-readable Inter body copy.
visualResetStrategy.resetComposition: Resets the asymmetrical tree layouts and center-symmetrical poetry blocks to a premium bento-grid launch layout with centered high-impact headings and flat outline features.
visualResetStrategy.resetMotion: Resets shutter overlays and slow fades to fast, snappy hover scaling (scale-102 ease-out) and snappy section reveals.
visualResetStrategy.regressionTestSafety: Passed. The layout, headings, interactive buttons, and bento cards are completely fresh, containing zero residue from any previous design iteration.

reviewRubric.tasteStandard: Oversized bold headlines, bento grids, pure white and pitch black surfaces, razor-thin lines, snappy hover scale feedback.
